Port St Lucie by the numbers

With about 220,453 residents, Port St Lucie is number 7 of the 132 fl places in this guide by population (Census Bureau, 2019-2023). Census respondents put the median owner-occupied home in Port St Lucie at $327,700, 2% below the fl median for these places. Renters live in about 17% of Port St Lucie homes, and owners in 83%, where the fl median is 66% owners. A median build year of 2001 puts the typical Port St Lucie house near 22 years old. These numbers describe Port St Lucie as a whole, so a given street can sit well above or below them.
